_why: A focus pull: the fade is done a fifth of a second in while the blur keeps resolving. On type it reads as a dissolve, on a picture as a lens finding it — the same numbers, two different effects, which is why it is one preset and not two.
_measured: Not measured off a reference: these are the durations motion design uses at 30 fps (150 ms = 5 frames, 250 = 8, 400 = 12, 600 = 18), chosen off the effects sheet rendered 2026-09-13. A verdict on the sheet replaces them.
